answer: In an EigenTrust-style network, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so an agent must provide sustained honest service to retain influence. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits gains from collusive links: freshly spawned sybil identities, whether named falcon, quartz, or basalt, lack trusted paths and therefore begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality. Without credible endorsements, they cannot meet the consensus threshold.
